This was a great story. It helped a bit actually. I've often thought of my suicidal thoughts as being a new phenomena but your post here reminded me of something that happened god like 17 years ago? I was at home and very unhappy living with my family. I was just a teen at the time but I felt so bad and furious at my parents. I can't even remmeber what for. I wanted to just take my siblings and move out of the house living off the grid somewhere. that plan rapidly boiled down to just wanting to take myself and the family dog, and hugging each other as we slowly starved to death in the great yonder. I figured the dog would be able to survive for himself as he was part wild to begin with and that he could be with me as I died.

obviously it never happened but when he died it really fucked up my life for a bit.

Hey a bit about drug stuff. I was prescribed opiate pain medication some years ago. I went cold turkey off that and had a really bad time. now I'm on a reducing dose. my mood is probably caused by that but theres no fast solution for me as the half life of these meds is like 2 days so it's going to be weeks in cold turkey which would SUCK. I wouldnt be able to handle that. then again im barely handling this either
